meta.title: Selected Projects & Case Studies | SGS
meta.description: Selected SGS projects and case studies: the Kimuka 2 utility-scale solar PV and BESS project in Kenya, a five-plant industrial wastewater treatment programme in Qatar, and the SGS EPC consortium for East Africa and MENA.

hero.title: Proven delivery across solar, storage, and water
hero.text: A focused set of EPC and infrastructure programmes — from utility-scale solar and battery storage in East Africa to industrial wastewater treatment in the Gulf — delivered by SGS and its multinational EPC consortium.

stories.kicker: Utility-Scale Solar PV + BESS · Kajiado County, Kenya
stories.title: Kimuka 2 Solar PV + BESS Project — 50.64 MWp DC / 40 MWac
stories.text: A 50.64 MWp DC / 40 MWac single-axis-tracker solar farm with a 10 MW / 20.06 MWh battery energy storage system, connected at 66 kV under a 20-year power purchase agreement. SGS has been selected as EPC contractor; the project is in development, with the EPC contract pending execution.
stories.image_alt: Aerial view of a utility-scale solar photovoltaic farm

stories.title: Qatar Industrial Wastewater Treatment Programme — five C-WWTP plants
stories.text: Engineering, construction, commissioning and continuous 24/7 operation of five industrial wastewater treatment plants across three sites, delivered to the discharge standards of Qatar's Public Works Authority over roughly five years of regulated operations.
stories.image_alt: Industrial wastewater treatment plant, aerial view

stories.title: SGS EPC Consortium — utility-scale solar, storage, and structured finance
stories.text: SGS International leads a multinational EPC consortium with ECEXA, Gretecsol GmbH, ROK Development and VOLARK — combining utility-scale PV and BESS delivery, grid connection, in-house engineering, structured EPCF, water and wastewater capability, and long-term O&M.
